answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 31603 Country: Pakistan Title: I have had a dream of going to London. Question: I have had a dream of going to London. ( IAM VERY FOND TO GO TO ABROAD ) i was very happy that I eventully arrived to London, I saw my parents and uncle they were already there but I came to know that i have got only for one week visa. Please interpret this dream for me. JAZAKUMULLAHUKHAIR. Answer ID: 31603 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 832/538/H=1432) It is nice dream. It means that the worldly life and its glittering are short-lived. It is foolish to spend it in unnecessary enjoyment and petty matters. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
